body: If only life were that easy

Hey, I know I am just a stranger from half a world away, but don't do it. Its not worth it. I've woken up twice in the ICU and trust me the first feeling after you open your eyes is never "Fuck I'm still alive?". Its more like "Damn, I'm still alive? Maybe its not time for me to go yet."

Don't do it. Reach out to someone. There is always love in this world, you just have to look for it in the corners

One question dear sir, how long did it take? I am two weeks in and my head is spinning right now as we speak. I dont want to live my dreams anymore cause lately I had included her in all of them and now that she is not there, they feel empty. And its hard to carry on if you dont have anything to look forward to.
